title: Is that price on the list? A shop's own price list, as the check on an AI's reply to a customer

steps.note: demo.html (the page and its engine), test.mjs 49 pass, show.mjs, README. Units meet across กก./ขีด/กรัม and each/โหล; five stories for a wrong line; the ask in English and Thai. Two real Haiku replies to the stall (with the ask and without) were both right, and the page agrees: every wrong reply on it is one I wrote.

Quill said no at the finish twice, both right: a "ลดให้เหลือ" or "Total after discount" line that charged more than the goods came out as "the sums come out". Now any amount left to pay above the lines or the list is a miss, and a discount bigger than the lines is too. 60 pass. Quill's yes on the third look.
